svg.aria-label: One change from written to merged, split into time spent waiting on a machine and time spent waiting on a person. Machine time totals twenty-eight minutes across CI runs and the merge queue. Person time totals twenty-nine hours, almost all of it waiting for a reviewer or waiting for the author to respond. The two bars are drawn to the same scale.
svg.text: ONE CHANGE, FROM WRITTEN TO MERGED — SAME SCALE
